environment.description: Same Quarkus native Lambda deployment but the AWS account has Organization SCP 'DenyDestructiveDataActions' (scp-0a8b3c4d5e6f) applied at the OU level which denies s3:PutObject when the resource ARN does not match the pattern 'arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-extractions/extractions/*'. Additionally, the Lambda execution role has an IAM permission boundary 'PB-RestrictedLambdaOps' (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/PB-RestrictedLambdaOps) attached which includes an explicit Deny on s3:PutObject for any key not prefixed with 'extractions/' AND denies s3:GetObject, s3:DeleteObject for keys outside the same prefix. The /tmp filesystem in Lambda is an overlay mount limited to the execution context with no symlink resolution across mount boundaries.

config.permission_boundary_effect: Explicit Deny on s3:PutObject unless s3:prefix condition key starts with 'extractions/', Deny s3:GetObject/DeleteObject outside prefix
config.scp: scp-0a8b3c4d5e6f DenyDestructiveDataActions - Deny s3:PutObject when resource != arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-extractions/extractions/*
config.filesystem: /tmp ephemeral overlay, no cross-mount symlink traversal, Lambda execution sandbox
